junctions.description: Root agent contract rendered from CONTRACT.md plus CONTRACT.host.md; Codex and OpenCode read it natively and root CLAUDE.md points at it
Claude Code project settings: minimal permission posture plus hook registrations, as an independent byte copy

Declared for registry parity; the root CLAUDE.md pointer already delivers the contract to Claude Code, so the engine keeps this path absent to avoid loading the contract twice. Not materialized by design: this is a secondary contract-render row (dst != AGENTS.md), the same predicate materialize.py itself uses to skip it (see materialize.py Engine.check, 'Every contract-render row is served by the root render').
Per-skill directory: one junction or symlink per selected skill, pruned on deselection (per_skill.claude)
Always-on and path-scoped rule files Claude Code auto-loads
Shared hook tree exposed at the Claude Code hook path
Codex project configuration as an independent byte copy; loads only in a trusted project
Codex hook registry: one dispatcher entry per event, as an independent byte copy
Shared hook tree exposed at the Codex hook path
Generated Codex skill catalog for selected skills only (build_codex_adapter.py)
OpenCode project configuration as an independent byte copy
OpenCode skill root linked to the generated selected-skill tree (per_skill.opencode)
OpenCode plugin bridge to the shared hook dispatcher
Plugin helper module the bridge imports; materialized so a copy-mode plugin can resolve its relative import
Generated OpenCode slash commands for selected skills only (build_opencode_adapter.py)

retired_destinations.description: Codex discovers repository skills only from the generated .agents/skills catalog
